description: Your OWN payment history with a recipient address: how many times, how recently, and whether this amount is typical. Call it before paying an address you have not confirmed. THIS IS NOT A REPUTATION SCORE and says nothing about whether the address is honest. A familiar address is NOT a safe address — keys get compromised. Never tell a user an address is "trusted" or "safe" on the basis of this. A `first-time-recipient` result is NOT a warning about the recipient — every legitimate relationship has a first payment. It is the moment to confirm the address through a second channel, because address substitution can only be caught before you send. Read `coverage`: float-lane payouts are NOT included, so "first time" can be wrong.
name: robyn_counterparty_check
title: Have I paid this address before?
